entry.title: Aon Center (Los Angeles)
entry.note: Exact-QID stepped footprint supplies the long axis; the owner’s aerial context places the entrance on the south-east Wilshire facade and helicopter pad on the southwest half of the roof. The separate adjoining parking structure is not duplicated. Small roof-service dimensions are reconstructed from aerial photographs; the 261.5184 m published roof datum excludes rooftop aerials. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
